The world-1 PhysicsWorldConfig is at rsp+0x40 (lea rdx,[rsp+0x40] before the Ne_PhysWorld_InitFromConfig call), so [rsp+0x108] = cfg+0xc8 = maxLargeGeoms, already read from the settings store (out pointer r12 = rsp+0x108, default 0x7d0) and already copied to the trigger-world config at rsp+0x140 (vmovaps [rsp+0x200] from [rsp+0x100]). A write to [rsp+0x108] here sizes only the world-1 large-geom pool (element 0x220, stride 0x230, pointer free list) that Ne_MoverCollision_BuildMoverShapes takes every VCQTC collision tile from. No branch lands inside the three movs; rsp is the function's frame (no push after the prologue).
